findings.claim: BWXT is described as the sole/monopoly manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors and reactor fuel for the entire US Navy fleet (Ohio, Virginia, Seawolf, Los Angeles and Columbia-class submarines; Nimitz and Ford-class aircraft carriers) — this is the company's largest segment (Government Operations); no alternative propulsion/reactor technology or competing supplier exists for this Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program work.
findings.source: BWX Technologies FY2025 Form 10-K (filed 2026-02-23, investors.bwxt.com); bwxt.com Naval Nuclear Propulsion sector page; BofA Securities analyst commentary cited in Yahoo Finance 'BWX Technologies Rides US Push For Military And Space Nuclear Power To New Highs'

findings.claim: In the medical-isotope space (BWXT Medical/Nordion), non-reactor alternative production technologies for Mo-99/Tc-99m — cyclotron-based Tc-99m production (TRIUMF/University of Alberta research) and accelerator-driven subcritical-fission facilities (e.g. SHINE Technologies, cited as under advanced construction with capacity potentially exceeding 75% of US Mo-99 demand) — have been identified by IAEA and National Academies reviews as substitutes to conventional reactor-irradiated-target isotope production that underpins BWXT's isotope supply model.
findings.source: National Academies Press, 'Molybdenum-99 for Medical Imaging' (NCBI Bookshelf NBK396165, ~2016); IAEA 'Non-HEU Production Technologies for Molybdenum-99 and Technetium-99m'

substitute_technology.note: 查證顯示核心 Government Operations（海軍核反應爐）無替代技術威脅（法定獨家供應商）；醫療同位素小分部（BWXT Medical）則存在文獻記載已久的非反應爐替代生產技術，惟查得來源多為 2013-2016 年舊報告，未查到 2026 當前 SHINE 等競爭產能對 BWXT Medical 營收實際侵蝕的最新數據（受限於 3 輪查詢上限）。
